features: SMART RING WITH CALLER NOTIFICATIONS - Receive incoming call alerts, vibration notifications, and selected app notifications directly on your finger so you never miss important updates while working, traveling, or exercising.

ADVANCED HEALTH TRACKING - Monitor Heart Rate, HRV, Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Sleep Quality, Stress Levels, Daily Activity, Step Count, Calories Burned, and wellness data with intelligent sensors designed for all-day monitoring.

BUILT-IN LED DISPLAY - The integrated LED display provides quick access to important information including battery status, activity tracking, health metrics, and essential notifications without reaching for your smartphone.

MULTIPLE SPORTS MODES & GESTURE CONTROL - Track walking, running, cycling, gym workouts, and other fitness activities while enjoying smart gesture control for compatible smartphone functions, enhancing convenience throughout your day.
PREMIUM MIDNIGHT BLACK FINISH - Modern and elegant Midnight Black color complements casual, business, and sports outfits for both men and women.
LONG BATTERY LIFE - Designed with energy-efficient technology to deliver extended battery performance for uninterrupted daily use.
BLUETOOTH CONNECTIVITY - Quickly pairs with compatible Android and iOS smartphones via Bluetooth for seamless synchronization of health and activity data.
IDEAL FOR DAILY HEALTH MONITORING - A smart wearable designed for fitness enthusiasts, professionals, students, travelers, and anyone looking to monitor their health and stay connected.
LIGHTWEIGHT & COMFORTABLE DESIGN - Made with a premium lightweight body that provides all-day comfort without interfering with daily activities or exercise.
SMART GESTURE CONTROL - Control compatible smartphone functions using intuitive hand gestures for added convenience during work, travel, or workouts.
